GRADE 5 ENGLISH LANGUAGE — TERM 3 EXAM

Grade: Grade 5
Subject: ENGLISH LANGUAGE
Time: 64 minutes

INSTRUCTIONS
1. Answer all questions.
2. Use neat handwriting.
2. For multiple choice, write the correct letter only.
3. For short answers, write clearly in the spaces provided.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A: Multiple Choice

1. About Writing 9.4.1 Mechanics of Writing: Punctuation Marks in a conversation with a classmate, which statement is correct?
   A. identify the apostrophe and exclamation mark in sentences,
   B. Learners should ignore Writing 9.4.1 Mechanics of Writing: Punctuation Marks completely.
   C. Writing 9.4.1 Mechanics of Writing: Punctuation Marks is only useful outside Kenya.
   D. There is no need to practise Writing 9.4.1 Mechanics of Writing: Punctuation Marks.

2. About Writing 9.4.1 Mechanics of Writing: Punctuation Marks when reading a story about Kenya, which statement is correct?
   A. punctuate sentences correctly using the apostrophe and the exclamation mark,
   B. Learners should ignore Writing 9.4.1 Mechanics of Writing: Punctuation Marks completely.
   C. Writing 9.4.1 Mechanics of Writing: Punctuation Marks is only useful outside Kenya.
   D. There is no need to practise Writing 9.4.1 Mechanics of Writing: Punctuation Marks.

3. About Writing 9.4.1 Mechanics of Writing: Punctuation Marks while writing in your exercise book, which statement is correct?
   A. identify the apostrophe and exclamation mark in sentences,
   B. Learners should ignore Writing 9.4.1 Mechanics of Writing: Punctuation Marks completely.
   C. Writing 9.4.1 Mechanics of Writing: Punctuation Marks is only useful outside Kenya.
   D. There is no need to practise Writing 9.4.1 Mechanics of Writing: Punctuation Marks.

5. About Listening and Speaking 10.1.1 Pronunciation and Vocabulary: Interactive Listenin in a conversation with a classmate, which statement is correct?
   A. recognise sounds /ʌ/ /ɑː /, words, and phrases correctly,
   B. Learners should ignore Listening and Speaking 10.1.1 Pronunciation and Vocabulary: Interactive Listenin completely.
   C. Listening and Speaking 10.1.1 Pronunciation and Vocabulary: Interactive Listenin is only useful outside Kenya.
   D. There is no need to practise Listening and Speaking 10.1.1 Pronunciation and Vocabulary: Interactive Listenin.

6. About Listening and Speaking 10.1.1 Pronunciation and Vocabulary: Interactive Listenin when reading a story about Kenya, which statement is correct?
   A. listen for the main idea and specific details for effective communication,
   B. Learners should ignore Listening and Speaking 10.1.1 Pronunciation and Vocabulary: Interactive Listenin completely.
   C. Listening and Speaking 10.1.1 Pronunciation and Vocabulary: Interactive Listenin is only useful outside Kenya.
   D. There is no need to practise Listening and Speaking 10.1.1 Pronunciation and Vocabulary: Interactive Listenin.

7. About Listening and Speaking 10.1.1 Pronunciation and Vocabulary: Interactive Listenin while writing in your exercise book, which statement is correct?
   A. recognise sounds /ʌ/ /ɑː /, words, and phrases correctly,
   B. Learners should ignore Listening and Speaking 10.1.1 Pronunciation and Vocabulary: Interactive Listenin completely.
   C. Listening and Speaking 10.1.1 Pronunciation and Vocabulary: Interactive Listenin is only useful outside Kenya.
   D. There is no need to practise Listening and Speaking 10.1.1 Pronunciation and Vocabulary: Interactive Listenin.

9. About Pronunciation and Vocabulary: Interactive Listening in a conversation with a classmate, which statement is correct?
   A. identify words, phrases, and sentences containing the target sounds/p/ /b/ from texts
   B. Learners should ignore Pronunciation and Vocabulary: Interactive Listening completely.
   C. Pronunciation and Vocabulary: Interactive Listening is only useful outside Kenya.
   D. There is no need to practise Pronunciation and Vocabulary: Interactive Listening.

10. About Pronunciation and Vocabulary: Interactive Listening when reading a story about Kenya, which statement is correct?
   A. construct sentences orally using words related to the theme,
   B. Learners should ignore Pronunciation and Vocabulary: Interactive Listening completely.
   C. Pronunciation and Vocabulary: Interactive Listening is only useful outside Kenya.
   D. There is no need to practise Pronunciation and Vocabulary: Interactive Listening.

11. About Pronunciation and Vocabulary: Interactive Listening while writing in your exercise book, which statement is correct?
   A. identify words, phrases, and sentences containing the target sounds/p/ /b/ from texts
   B. Learners should ignore Pronunciation and Vocabulary: Interactive Listening completely.
   C. Pronunciation and Vocabulary: Interactive Listening is only useful outside Kenya.
   D. There is no need to practise Pronunciation and Vocabulary: Interactive Listening.

13. About Reading 10.2.1 Intensive Reading in a conversation with a classmate, which statement is correct?
   A. relate the ideas in a text to their experiences for comprehension,
   B. Learners should ignore Reading 10.2.1 Intensive Reading completely.
   C. Reading 10.2.1 Intensive Reading is only useful outside Kenya.
   D. There is no need to practise Reading 10.2.1 Intensive Reading.

14. About Reading 10.2.1 Intensive Reading when reading a story about Kenya, which statement is correct?
   A. respond to direct and inferential questions from a text correctly,
   B. Learners should ignore Reading 10.2.1 Intensive Reading completely.
   C. Reading 10.2.1 Intensive Reading is only useful outside Kenya.
   D. There is no need to practise Reading 10.2.1 Intensive Reading.

15. About Reading 10.2.1 Intensive Reading while writing in your exercise book, which statement is correct?
   A. summarise the main ideas in a text for comprehension,
   B. Learners should ignore Reading 10.2.1 Intensive Reading completely.
   C. Reading 10.2.1 Intensive Reading is only useful outside Kenya.
   D. There is no need to practise Reading 10.2.1 Intensive Reading.

17. About Word Class: Conjunctions in a conversation with a classmate, which statement is correct?
   A. identify conjunctions: but, or, yet, because, since and also, in texts for effective communication,
   B. Learners should ignore Word Class: Conjunctions completely.
   C. Word Class: Conjunctions is only useful outside Kenya.
   D. There is no need to practise Word Class: Conjunctions.

   B. Learners should ignore Word Class: Conjunctions completely.
   C. Word Class: Conjunctions is only useful outside Kenya.
   D. There is no need to practise Word Class: Conjunctions.

   B. Learners should ignore Word Class: Conjunctions completely.
   C. Word Class: Conjunctions is only useful outside Kenya.
   D. There is no need to practise Word Class: Conjunctions.

21. About Writing 10.4.1 Creative Writing: Descriptive Composition in a conversation with a classmate, which statement is correct?
   A. describe people or things mentioned in a text,
   B. Learners should ignore Writing 10.4.1 Creative Writing: Descriptive Composition completely.
   C. Writing 10.4.1 Creative Writing: Descriptive Composition is only useful outside Kenya.
   D. There is no need to practise Writing 10.4.1 Creative Writing: Descriptive Composition.

22. About Writing 10.4.1 Creative Writing: Descriptive Composition when reading a story about Kenya, which statement is correct?
   A. create a descriptive composition related to the theme for effective communication,
   B. Learners should ignore Writing 10.4.1 Creative Writing: Descriptive Composition completely.
   C. Writing 10.4.1 Creative Writing: Descriptive Composition is only useful outside Kenya.
   D. There is no need to practise Writing 10.4.1 Creative Writing: Descriptive Composition.

23. About Writing 10.4.1 Creative Writing: Descriptive Composition while writing in your exercise book, which statement is correct?
   A. critique a composition on the choice of words, creativity, relevance to theme and logical flow,
   B. Learners should ignore Writing 10.4.1 Creative Writing: Descriptive Composition completely.
   C. Writing 10.4.1 Creative Writing: Descriptive Composition is only useful outside Kenya.
   D. There is no need to practise Writing 10.4.1 Creative Writing: Descriptive Composition.

25. About Listening and Speaking 11.1.1 Pronunciation and Vocabulary in a conversation with a classmate, which statement is correct?
   A. recognise sounds /ʌ/ /ɑː /, words, and phrases correctly,
   B. Learners should ignore Listening and Speaking 11.1.1 Pronunciation and Vocabulary completely.
   C. Listening and Speaking 11.1.1 Pronunciation and Vocabulary is only useful outside Kenya.
   D. There is no need to practise Listening and Speaking 11.1.1 Pronunciation and Vocabulary.

   D. There is no need to practise Listening and Speaking 11.1.1 Pronunciation and Vocabulary.
